job.theme: a cricket match between two schools
job.style: a news-style report about a real-world situation

response.passage: On 14th November, the annual inter-school cricket final between Green Valley Academy and St. Jude’s High took place at the Nehru Stadium. The atmosphere was electric as over 500 spectators gathered to witness the clash. Green Valley batted first, setting a target of 145 runs. Their captain, Rohan Sharma, played a brilliant innings, scoring 62 runs before being caught at the boundary. St. Jude’s struggled initially against the spin bowling of Vikram Singh, who took four wickets in his opening spell. However, the match turned in the final over when the pitch conditions changed due to the sudden evening dew. Because the dew made the ball slippery, the bowlers could not grip it properly, allowing the St. Jude’s tail-enders to score the winning runs. The match concluded with a thrilling victory for St. Jude’s, who celebrated their hard-fought win under the floodlights. The tournament organizers praised both teams for their sportsmanship and dedication throughout the season.
response.summary: St. Jude’s High defeated Green Valley Academy in a thrilling cricket final at Nehru Stadium. The match was decided in the final over when slippery conditions made bowling difficult. Both teams were commended for their excellent performance and spirit.
